item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines a `dspy.Signature` with `text` input and `number: int` output, wraps it in `dspy.Predict`, and builds a tiny `Example(...).with_inputs('text')` dataset."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Uses a JSON-adapted `DummyLM` that returns one valid `{\"number\": 1}` completion and one malformed text completion, then calls `bootstrap_trace_data` with exact-match metric, `raise_on_error=False`, and `capture_failed_parses=True`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Checks the successful result remains a normal parsed prediction via `assert res[0]['prediction'].number == 1`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Verifies the failed case is a `FailedPrediction`, preserves raw bad text in `completion_text`, and has a non-empty `trace`."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
